primary_justification: This packet contains both aggregate total rows and real position rows. The HTML coordinates show current-period issuer/instrument rows for Discovery Purchaser, Geo Parent, and TruGreen, while the same bundle also shows total debt/cash-and-investment rows that should be documented as totals rather than positions.
